g.text: Every tab is a level, set in the VT323 font with hand-made pixel sprites.
The EXP bar fills with the song. Finish a track and you LEVEL UP!
An inventory grid. Drop a file for +1 ITEM; remove it and it shatters into pixels.
A treasure chest. Drag a file near and the lid opens, gold glittering.
ALWAYS ALLOW: BASH(NPM TEST:*), THIS SESSION
An RPG dialog box: text types out letter by letter, pick with the ▶ cursor.
